summary: Explains community.general.random_mac (2.6+) to generate a random MAC from a prefix, erroring on bad prefixes, and seeding with inventory_hostname (2.9+) for idempotent results.
questions: How do I generate a random MAC address in Ansible?
How do I make a random MAC stable per host?

answer_card.title: Generating random MAC addresses
answer_card.answer_md:
```jinja
{{ '52:54:00' | community.general.random_mac }}
# => '52:54:00:ef:1c:03'
```

Idempotent per host (2.9+):

```jinja
{{ '52:54:00' | community.general.random_mac(seed=inventory_hostname) }}
```

Requires the community.general collection; a bad prefix raises an error.
